purposes.near_triangles: First measured simplification candidate; inspect the shield, face and silhouette before selecting a final budget.
purposes.mid_triangles: Retain the tusks and coat after the 36k collapse proved too aggressive at encounter distance; not an automatic game LOD switch.
purposes.far_triangles: Distant silhouette candidate, preserving broad shield and tusks.
purposes.far_voxel_metres: Distant volume sampling closes small generated gaps before simplification; larger values erase fine silhouette detail.
purposes.far_texture_pixels: Rebaked distant material and scar atlas; compare at 18 metres.
purposes.normal_pixels: Bake fine bristles, plate relief and the shallow scar into the retained UV atlas.
purposes.breath_metres: Gentle idle motion, with analytic limb targets rather than hovering hooves.
purposes.stance_sink_metres: Settle the shoulders into reachable planted-hoof poses; leaning additionally lowers the body by its raised hip displacement.
purposes.step_metres: Short in-place walking preview; actual game travel/stride adaptation remains separate.
purposes.hoof_lift_metres: Clear the ground during swing while keeping the stance hoof flat.
purposes.root_radians: Bound the head's ordinary rooting pose without adding a gameplay action.
purposes.turn_radians: Review neck and plate clearance during a modest head turn.
purposes.windup_radians: Existing CreatureMotion's 0.13 rad anticipation, sampled over the native melee windup.
purposes.release_radians: Existing CreatureMotion's 0.17 rad response, displayed during its 0.22-second release window.
purposes.release_head_lift_radians: Lift the already lowered muzzle through the release so solid tusks clear the floor; does not change the attack clock, reach or collision.
